subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require native WebChat parity in the same implementation, or should a complete Control UI fix land first with native parity tracked separately?
rationale: The Control UI gap and repair boundary are clear, but the issue describes native WebChat only as “if applicable,” and the browser and SwiftUI stacks require independent implementation and proof.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Land complete safe coverage for Control UI and open or retain a separate native WebChat follow-up only if maintainers want parity.

options.title: Require both stacks
options.body: Keep one completion gate requiring safe link rendering and real behavior proof in both Control UI and native WebChat.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Land complete safe coverage for Control UI and open or retain a separate native WebChat follow-up only if maintainers want parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the latest issue-side review connect this person to both rendering stacks and the outstanding scope choice.
